message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R11]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is safe for autistic children and highly enjoyable.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "it makes my autism just so happy, lego team really did something amazing here so props to them!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R12]",
      "area": "tutorial",
      "claim": "A parent reports the tutorial is forced and under-communicated, causing frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I HATE tutorials and minimalist zen nonsense. I started the game and dumbly followed their obvious and unnecessary tutorial until I got to the phase that says “use two fingers to look around”. I did. I looked around… and nothing happened. Whatever is supposed to happen next is either BROKEN or intentionally under-communicated for “zen effect”, which is maddeningly frustrating."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R13]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports the controls are finicky and lack visual feedback for brick placement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It's potentially really fun but the controls are so finicky that it kills the fun. Why not put a highlight on the area where the bricks are going to go? Instead you just have to hope you're hovering over the right spot."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R16]",
      "area": "scary_content",
      "claim": "A parent reports scary scenes and a sad story that could frighten young children.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "it has scary scenes that could scare little children and has a sad story. I don’t like that the last level is so hard."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R18]",
      "area": "creative_mode",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game includes a creative mode for building anything.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The music is very calm😌 and the Lego animation is perfect👍 ,and I also like how this game has creative mode so we can build anything."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R24]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports the developer has released an unfinished beta with unresolved core issues.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game feels like somethign someone started, but didn't finish. That said, the core graphics are beautiful and special in 3D in a way they wouldn't be in 2D. And the idea of playing with legos in this space is spectacular. Hopefully the devs finish this game or it inspires others."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R26]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports the controls are annoying and make the game a chore to play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Annoying controls The controls make the game a chore to play"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R27]",
      "area": "accessibility",
      "claim": "A parent reports difficulty seeing small details due to age-related vision issues.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I guess my eyes have reach the point of old age because I really wish I could zoom in a little. And sometimes I don’t know what I’m supposed to do."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R33]",
      "area": "glitch",
      "claim": "A parent reports a bug prevents progression at 94% completion, making the game unbeatable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I’ve reached the 94 percent mark and I was very excited to finish the game. Unfortunately, I realize that the next level is unbeatable because of a glitch. The robot character is supposed to appear, and yet there are no characters or other interactive objects in the level."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R34]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app cannot be deleted.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "You cannot delete the app"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R40]",
      "area": "storage",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game requires 1.4GB of storage, which is problematic on a 64GB device.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Takes so much storeage takes 1.4gigabytes and I only have 64 gigabytes on my iPhone 8"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R42]",
      "area": "calming",
      "claim": "A parent with anxiety reports the game is calming and emotionally soothing.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Hello so i don’t really write reviews much but this game deserves it i have anxiety and this game is so calming and the story is sad though NOT GONNA SPOIL!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R44]",
      "area": "freeze",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app freezes during Apple Arcade animation, preventing play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I’ve been unable to play the app, freezes on the Apple Arcade animation"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R46]",
      "area": "length",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is too short, finishing quickly despite enjoyment.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "It is short"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R47]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports poor controls on iPad, making the game hard to use.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Poor controls I love the concept but, at least on my iPad, the controls are horrible."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R48]",
      "area": "tutorial",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks instructions and tutorial, causing confusion.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "There’s no introduction, and no tutorial or instructions."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R50]",
      "area": "difficulty",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is too easy and lacks challenge.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Kind of too easy I like playing the game and all but it’s kind of easy and I got through it really quick"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R51]",
      "area": "story",
      "claim": "A parent reports the story resonates emotionally with adults, depicting a father-son relationship.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "So thank you, I don’t know the last time I felt something from a video game, and this one was wonderful."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R52]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports touch controls fail to respond to dragging for camera movement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Can’t get past drag with 2 fingers no matter what way or for how long I drag to look around."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R53]",
      "area": "deletion",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app cannot be deleted.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "You cannot delete the app"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R55]",
      "area": "tutorial",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks instructions, making basic actions like placing bricks difficult.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "No tutorial, after hours of use have only been able to figure out rotate and put down. I have discovered the “quicksand”. Half the time I try to Force Touch to put a brick down nothing happens."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R56]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports controls are clunky, causing issues like getting stuck in mud.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls need some work Along with some other people, I can agree that the controls are a little clunky. It does make it hard to do things like get out of mud quick enough so that you don’t sink and have to start over."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R61]",
      "area": "storage",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game consumes excessive storage (1.4GB), preventing installation on a 64GB device.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Takes so much storeage takes 1.4gigabytes and I only have 64 gigabytes on my iPhone 8"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R66]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A parent reports controls defeat the game's purpose due to poor touch implementation.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls defeats the purpose Came here to leave a review for the developer about how awful the controls are. But noticed people have been complaining about the controls for a year and developer has done nothing about."
    }
  ]
}
